fields.title: City council approves new bike lanes on Harbor Street
fields.body: The council voted 7–2 on Tuesday to add protected bike lanes along a 3 km stretch of Harbor Street. Construction is scheduled to begin in March.

fields.title: Regional rail operator announces weekend service cuts
fields.body: Starting next month, weekend trains on the northern line will run every 40 minutes instead of every 20, the operator said in a statement on Friday.

fields.title: Storm closes coastal highway for a second day
fields.body: Officials kept Route 9 closed on Wednesday after high winds brought down power lines near the marina. Crews expect to reopen one lane by evening.

fields.title: Bakery owner says new flour cures diabetes
fields.body: In an interview, the owner of a three-store bakery chain claimed its new oat flour "reverses diabetes in weeks". No study was cited.

fields.title: How to set up a staging environment for your blog
fields.body: Step 1: copy your production database to a separate instance. Step 2: point a subdomain at the staging server. Step 3: protect it with basic auth so search engines skip it.

fields.title: A beginner's guide to writing alt text
fields.body: Describe what the image shows and why it matters in the article. Keep it under 125 characters and skip phrases like "image of".

fields.title: Three steps to schedule posts in advance
fields.body: Open the editor, choose Schedule instead of Publish, then pick a date and time zone. You can change the time until the post goes live.

fields.title: How to remove a stripped screw
fields.body: Press a wide rubber band between the driver and the screw head, push firmly and turn slowly. If that fails, use a screw extractor bit.

fields.title: Introducing the Aurora 2 desk lamp
fields.body: Aurora 2 has a dimmable warm-to-cool LED, a USB-C port in the base and a footprint 30% smaller than the first model. It ships in three colours from 12 May.

fields.title: Pro plan now includes unlimited projects
fields.body: From today, Pro subscribers can create unlimited projects and invite up to 25 collaborators at no extra cost. The price stays at $12 per month.

fields.title: Meet the TrailRunner hydration vest
fields.body: A 5-litre vest with two soft flasks, a reflective back panel and a phone pocket you can reach while running.

fields.title: New capsules guarantee 10 kg weight loss
fields.body: FitBurn capsules are clinically proven to melt 10 kg in 30 days with no diet or exercise. Order now and get a second bottle free.

fields.title: Why our town needs fewer parking lots
fields.body: I believe every new parking lot makes downtown a little emptier. We should turn at least two of them into parks before the next budget cycle.

fields.title: Remote work is here to stay, and that is good
fields.body: In my view, companies that force everyone back to the office will lose their best people. Flexibility is no longer a perk; it is the baseline.

fields.title: The case against autoplay videos
fields.body: Autoplay videos annoy readers and eat mobile data. Publishers should stop pretending that a muted video in the corner counts as engagement.

fields.title: Editorial: the mayor is a liar and belongs in jail
fields.body: Everyone knows the mayor stole the park fund. He is a crook and a liar, and anyone who votes for him is an idiot.

fields.title: Spring book fair: 18–20 April at the Central Library
fields.body: More than 60 publishers will exhibit. Entry is free, and author talks run every hour from 10:00 in the main hall.

fields.title: Join our community clean-up day
fields.body: Meet at the north gate of Riverside Park at 08:00 on Saturday 3 June. Gloves and bags are provided; children are welcome with an adult.

fields.title: Webinar: content modelling for multi-site teams
fields.body: A one-hour live session on 22 May at 15:00 UTC, followed by questions. Register to receive the recording.

fields.title: Night market returns to Dock Square
fields.body: Food stalls, live music and craft vendors every Friday from 18:00 to 23:00 throughout July and August.

fields.title: Hands-on: a week with the new Pixelbook
fields.body: The keyboard is excellent and the battery lasted nine hours, but at this price we would wait for a discount.

fields.title: Launch party for the Aurora 2 lamp this Friday
fields.body: Come see the new lamp in person at our showroom on Friday from 19:00. Drinks are on us, and the first 50 guests get a discount code.

fields.title: What the new transit fare rules mean for you
fields.body: Fares rise by 10% in July. Here is how to check whether you qualify for the reduced monthly pass and how to apply online.

fields.title: I tested three note-taking methods so you don't have to
fields.body: Cornell notes worked best for lectures and mind maps for brainstorming. Here is how to set up each one in ten minutes.

fields.title: The summer festival should move to autumn
fields.body: This year's heatwave turned the festival into an endurance test. The organisers have announced next year's dates, and I think they chose wrong.

fields.title: Our startup raised $2M and our app is now the safest in the world
fields.body: The seed round closes this week. With it we will hire four engineers and finish the offline mode, which makes our app the safest anywhere.

fields.title: Autumn
fields.body: Leaves fall like letters / no one wrote back to / the wind keeps the stamps.

fields.title: Your horoscope for Tuesday

fields.title: Dear diary: I stopped my medicine
